name: Lu4 Wiki: NPC Soulless Wild Boar

links.name: Raid Boss Lv. 1 If the person who made the greatest contribution is 3 or more Lv.s higher than the raid monster, then the item/Adena rewards will decrease. If the difference is 9 or more Lv.s, the monster will drop nothing at all.

Raid Boss Lv. 1 A wild boar that had its soul stolen by an evil mystic's experiment, transforming the beast into a killing machine. It eventually killed the mystic, but this could not give it peace. It searches for a powerful entity that can finally give its soul rest.

Animals Lv. 4 Takes 15% increased damage from attacks that are effective against Animals. P. Crit. Rate +25 Speed +5 P. Def. -5% Resistance to Bleed -15% Resistance to Speed Down +20% Resistance to Bow -10%
